response.overview: As night falls, JOKO, an online motorcycle ride-hailing driver, struggles to get orders after receiving a poor rating earlier that day. His wife, KIRANA, calls to ask where he is. Joko shares his frustration with the pressure of difficult customers, platform fees, paid service programs, and the lack of support for online drivers. Kirana then tells him that a debt collector has come to their home because they are still Rp100,000 short on a payment. Determined to earn enough before returning home, Joko continues waiting for an order. He eventually receives a request to deliver an urgent package to another city. Although he initially hesitates because of the long distance, he accepts after learning how important the package is to the customer. After collecting it from the post office, Joko sets off on a 38-kilometer journey that pushes his endurance, determination, and hope to their limits.
response.title: OTW
